# BTicino C300X Native Agent Integration v0.3.1

Maintenance release focused on safer agent updates, MQTT migration, and runtime
diagnostics.

## Highlights

- Home Assistant Repairs can update a mismatched native C300X agent through the
  maintenance API after the initial SSH bootstrap.
- Native-agent bundles are hash-checked and unchanged files are skipped to avoid
  unnecessary writes on the C300X.
- Legacy `TcpDump2Mqtt` installs can be disabled or removed through guarded
  maintenance controls, with broker settings preserved for the native MQTT
  bridge.
- New diagnostics expose safe runtime health details such as write counters,
  wake reason, open file descriptors, and video bridge state.
- Native-agent stack usage is now checked in CI for the ARMHF target.

## Security and Privacy

- Agent updates are explicit and user-confirmed through Repairs.
- SSH credentials are not needed for normal self-updates after the first
  bootstrap install.
- Uploaded update files are SHA-256 checked before apply.
- Update and migration flows do not run automatically on every Home Assistant
  start.
